=== FrFlowGen/Calls/Again/Spec.lean ===
-- GENERATED by FrFlow from the Scala model. Do not edit.

import FrFlowGen.Calls.Types
import FrFlowGen.Calls.Domain.Def_viaPick
import FrFlowGen.Calls.PickPromise.Spec

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Calls.Again

@[frflow_defs] def post (minPages : Int) : (List Book) → Int → (List Book) → Prop :=
  fun (shelf : (List Book)) (n : Int) (picked : (List Book)) => (∀ b ∈ picked, ((b ∈ shelf) ∧ (b.pages ≥ minPages)))

@[frflow_defs] def claim (minPages : Int) (again : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x0 : (List Book)) (x1 : Int), (Calls.Again.post minPages) x0 x1 (again x0 x1)

namespace Obl

/-- Every result of viaPick meets Again, given what PickPromise promise. -/
@[frflow_defs] def impl : Prop :=
  ∀ (minPages : Int) (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)), ∀ (h_PickPromise : (Calls.PickPromise.claim minPages picks)), (Calls.Again.claim minPages (Calls.viaPick picks))

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- No world meets Again. -/
@[frflow_defs] def unsat : Prop :=
  ∀ (minPages : Int) (again : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)), ¬ (Calls.Again.claim minPages again)

end Obl

frflow_match_eqns

end Calls.Again

=== FrFlowGen/Calls/Again/Theorems.lean ===
-- GENERATED by FrFlow from the Scala model. Do not edit.

import FrFlowGen.Calls.Again.Spec

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Calls.Again

/-- Again holds of every world that meets the leaves below it: Again. -/
theorem holds : ∀ (minPages : Int) (again : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)), ∀ (h_Again : (Calls.Again.claim minPages again)), (Calls.Again.claim minPages again) := by
  intro minPages again h_Again
  exact h_Again

end Calls.Again

=== FrFlowGen/Calls/Domain/Def_longOnes.lean ===
-- GENERATED by FrFlow from the Scala model. Do not edit.

import FrFlowGen.Calls.Types

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Calls

@[frflow_defs] def longOnes (minPages : Int) : (List Book) → Int → (List Book) :=
  fun (shelf : (List Book)) (n : Int) => (List.filter (fun b => decide (b.pages ≥ minPages)) shelf)

frflow_match_eqns

end Calls

=== FrFlowGen/Calls/Domain/Def_viaPick.lean ===
-- GENERATED by FrFlow from the Scala model. Do not edit.

import FrFlowGen.Calls.Types

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Calls

@[frflow_defs] def viaPick (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) : (List Book) → Int → (List Book) :=
  fun (shelf : (List Book)) (n : Int) => (List.filter (fun b => decide (b ∈ shelf)) (picks shelf n))

frflow_match_eqns

end Calls

=== FrFlowGen/Calls/PickPromise/Spec.lean ===
-- GENERATED by FrFlow from the Scala model. Do not edit.

import FrFlowGen.Calls.Types
import FrFlowGen.Calls.Domain.Def_longOnes

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Calls.PickPromise

@[frflow_defs] def post (minPages : Int) : (List Book) → Int → (List Book) → Prop :=
  fun (shelf : (List Book)) (n : Int) (picked : (List Book)) => (∀ b ∈ picked, ((b ∈ shelf) ∧ (b.pages ≥ minPages)))

@[frflow_defs] def claim (minPages : Int) (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x0 : (List Book)) (x1 : Int), (Calls.PickPromise.post minPages) x0 x1 (picks x0 x1)

namespace Obl

/-- Every result of longOnes meets PickPromise. -/
@[frflow_defs] def impl : Prop :=
  ∀ (minPages : Int), (Calls.PickPromise.claim minPages (Calls.longOnes minPages))

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- No world meets PickPromise. -/
@[frflow_defs] def unsat : Prop :=
  ∀ (minPages : Int) (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)), ¬ (Calls.PickPromise.claim minPages picks)

end Obl

frflow_match_eqns

end Calls.PickPromise

=== FrFlowGen/Calls/PickPromise/Theorems.lean ===
-- GENERATED by FrFlow from the Scala model. Do not edit.

import FrFlowGen.Calls.PickPromise.Spec

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Calls.PickPromise

/-- PickPromise holds of every world that meets the leaves below it: PickPromise. -/
theorem holds : ∀ (minPages : Int) (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)), ∀ (h_PickPromise : (Calls.PickPromise.claim minPages picks)), (Calls.PickPromise.claim minPages picks) := by
  intro minPages picks h_PickPromise
  exact h_PickPromise

end Calls.PickPromise

=== FrFlowGen/Calls/PickedAgain/Auto.lean ===
-- GENERATED by FrFlow from the Scala model. Do not edit.

import FrFlowGen.Calls.PickedAgain.Spec

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Calls.PickedAgain.Auto
open Calls.PickedAgain

set_option linter.unusedSimpArgs false in
theorem complete : Obl.complete := by
  unfold Obl.complete
  first
    | (intro again minPages h_Again
       simp only [Calls.PickedAgain.claim, Calls.Again.claim, Calls.Again.post, List.forall_mem_map, forall_and] at h_Again ⊢
       revert h_Again
       try simp only [and_imp]
       repeat' (first | (with_reducible assumption) | (with_reducible intro _) | (with_reducible apply And.intro))
       done)
    | frflow_auto

end Calls.PickedAgain.Auto

=== FrFlowGen/Calls/PickedAgain/Spec.lean ===
-- GENERATED by FrFlow from the Scala model. Do not edit.

import FrFlowGen.Calls.Types
import FrFlowGen.Calls.Again.Spec

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Calls.PickedAgain

@[frflow_defs] def claim (again : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) (minPages : Int) : Prop :=
  (∀ (l : (List Book)) (n : Int), (∀ b ∈ (again l n), ((b ∈ l) ∧ (b.pages ≥ minPages))))

namespace Obl

/-- The parts of PickedAgain (Again) together make it. -/
@[frflow_defs] def complete : Prop :=
  ∀ (again : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) (minPages : Int), ∀ (h_Again : (Calls.Again.claim minPages again)), (Calls.PickedAgain.claim again minPages)

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- PickedAgain holds whatever Again says. -/
@[frflow_defs] def vacuous : Prop :=
  ∀ (again : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) (minPages : Int), (Calls.PickedAgain.claim again minPages)

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- Again follows from PickedAgain. -/
@[frflow_defs] def restates : Prop :=
  ∀ (again : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) (minPages : Int), ∀ (h_PickedAgain : (Calls.PickedAgain.claim again minPages)), (Calls.Again.claim minPages again)

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- The parts of PickedAgain contradict each other. -/
@[frflow_defs] def clash : Prop :=
  ∀ (again : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) (minPages : Int), ∀ (h_Again : (Calls.Again.claim minPages again)), False

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- No world meets PickedAgain. -/
@[frflow_defs] def unsat : Prop :=
  ∀ (again : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) (minPages : Int), ¬ (Calls.PickedAgain.claim again minPages)

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- PickedAgain is met by doing nothing (again: returning nothing). -/
@[frflow_defs] def idle : Prop :=
  ∀ (minPages : Int), (Calls.PickedAgain.claim (fun (x0 : (List Book)) (x1 : Int) => []) minPages)

end Obl

frflow_match_eqns

end Calls.PickedAgain

import FrFlowGen.Calls.PickedAgain.Auto

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Calls.PickedAgain

/-- PickedAgain holds of every world that meets the leaves below it: Again. -/
theorem holds : ∀ (again : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) (minPages : Int), ∀ (h_Again : (Calls.Again.claim minPages again)), (Calls.PickedAgain.claim again minPages) := by
  intro again minPages h_Again
  exact Calls.PickedAgain.Auto.complete (again := again) (minPages := minPages) (h_Again := h_Again)

end Calls.PickedAgain

  intro minPages
